material_review_questions: Which competencies are required by this change?
Which are covered and which remain unreviewed?
What is current state of the art or accepted method where freshness matters?
Which best practices apply only under assumptions that differ from this project?
What unknown unknowns should a specialist perspective surface?
What is the simplest project-fit option and what would make us reconsider it?
synthesis_rule: Specialist perspectives are inputs; the project decision must integrate them against objective, constraints, evidence, risk, reversibility and maintenance burden.
